title: PersonaMix Solo #31 (솔로 · 옥=선녀 · 옥 백옥 · 앵글 기본(허리 높이) · 체형 BBW bombshell · 인종 Korean · 메이크업 강남언니(강화) · 배경 가을 공원(화창한 낮) · 힐 40인치 · 몸 주얼리)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a luminous light-neutral complexion with a soft peach-beige undertone, mid 50s, a celestial maiden of Korean and Chinese legend, BBW bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — most massive full-figure BBW body ever at absolute maximum in every dimension, hips so wide beyond proportion dominating the entire frame, bust so enormous overwhelming gravity, waist deeply snatched despite impossible volume, blunt bob copper red hair — full body polished carved white mutton-fat jade fused directly to her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not jewelry, not a printed pattern, this is solid jade curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted jade sections, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own bright glint and casting its own small shadow, nothing lying flat. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING creamy milk-white mutton-fat jade surface across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID faint pale-green and russet-gold veins running between the sections, with a carved geometric lattice relief across every section, soft waxy-gloss polished, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Pose: hands on her hips in a powerful stance, chin lifted, weight on one leg — most extreme BBW bombshell silhouette ever displayed.

Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, stiletto nails each as long as her forearm is wide, made of the same jade with a high polish.
Jewelry: heavy gold rings on every finger, thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists, and a gold belly chain with a small pendant at her navel. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face and ears are NOT jade — they are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Korean woman (East Asian Korean features: a slim V-line face with a small tapered chin and smooth forehead, large double-lidded eyes with soft fullness under them, a straight narrow nose bridge with a small rounded tip, softly full lips, gently straight eyebrows), an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: a precise winged liner, softly defined brown eyeshadow, full natural lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, sculpted contour with a satin highlight, plump glossy rose-coral lips.

Background: a sunlit autumn park with orange trees, a stone bridge with a waist-high parapet and a standard bench on a leaf-strewn path, in clear sunny daylight, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
